name: Silent Lance
description: Thrust a lance of soul force with no sound and no warning through the centre of a guard of will.

name: Parting Veil
description: Draw aside the veil that holds a foe's thoughts together and leave them standing in plain disorder.

name: Pale Salvo
description: Loose a pale volley of soul force that strikes every will in front of the user at once.

name: Pressing Dusk
description: Let a deepening dusk of force settle on the target's will until their light of purpose dims.

name: Will Reaving
description: Reave a long strip of will from a soul in one cast so that no guard on it can matter.

name: Inner Silence
description: Seal the target's inner voice in a total silence so no technique can be willed into being.

name: Swallowed Blow
description: Swallow an incoming soul blow whole into the will and send back a stroke built from its force.

name: Distant Reckoning
description: Gather force across many breaths and settle accounts with a soul at the very limit of reach.

name: Veiled Verdict
description: The canon's stroke that passes the guard unseen and ends the thought the foe was about to form.

name: Reigning Hush
description: The canon's command of silence that lays a whole battle's worth of will under one stillness.

name: Mind Ending
description: Bring the full weight of the weapon soul down on every mind in reach up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Foreknown Blow
description: Strike a soul so that it remembers the blow before it fell and finds the wound already old.
